name: Tachikawa Kazuya
source:
A highly respected instructor, Kazuya is one of the rare male lecturers in an all girls academy. While he has always maintained a professional relationship with his students, there has always been a twinge of unhappiness that he is surrounded by so many beautiful women. This state of affairs quickly changes following his terrible accident.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175338/www.elizar.com/?p=30]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
